summary: # PDFtk Server Manual Reference - **`pdftk` version 2.02** - Check [version history](https://www.pdflabs.com/docs/pdftk-version-history/) for changes - See [server manual](https://www.pdflabs.com/docs/pdftk-man-page/) for the latest documentation ## Overview PDFtk is a command-line utility for manipulating PDF documents. It enables operations including merging, splitting, rotating, encrypting, decrypting, watermarking, form-filling, and metadata extraction of PDF files. ## Synopsis ``` pdftk [input PDF files | - | PROMPT] [input_pw <passwords>]
